title: Atlas Edit Proposal — 2026-11-09
body:
## Summary

This proposal includes the following edits:

- **Add weETH As Eligible Collateral For Morpho Vaults** - Adds weETH as eligible collateral for Morpho vaults and sets a 60,000 weETH exposure cap shared between Spark and Grove.
- **Add Morpho Vault Curation Governance Process** - Defines which changes to Morpho vaults used by Prime Agents require governance approval and which require only disclosure, with announcement and reporting requirements. Adds a Morpho Vault Change Note Template that may be used instead of the Technical Scope Template for qualifying changes.
- **Define The Governance Poll Process** - Consolidates the rules for creating, reviewing, publishing and voting on Governance Polls into a single process definition.
- **Replenish The Demand Side Buffer Through The Monthly Settlement Cycle** - Replenishes the Demand Side Buffer monthly through the Monthly Settlement Cycle and updates how its payments are recognized as Expenses.
- **Update Recognized Audit Firm Categories** - Renames the audit firm tiers to Category 1 and Category 2, and moves OpenZeppelin, ConsenSys Diligence and Trail Of Bits to Category 1.
- **Add Spark Foundation Grant For December 2026** - Authorizes the December 2026 grants to the Spark Foundation and the Spark Asset Foundation.
- **Add Grove Foundation Grant For November 2026** - Authorizes the November 2026 grant to the Grove Foundation.
- **Add CCTP Facet Controller Functions** - Adds the CCTP Facet's Controller functions and specifies the ERC-4626 emergency withdrawal on chains other than Ethereum Mainnet.
- **Add Osero To The Base Parallelized Allocation System** - Adds Osero's Diamond PAU on Base ahead of the November 19, 2026 Executive Vote.
- **Update The Osero Artifact For The November 19, 2026 Executive Vote** - Adds Osero's allocations on Base and updates the parameters of its Osero x Gauntlet USDC Prime vault.
- **Clarify Audit Recordkeeping Requirements** - Clarifies where audit records for Spells and deployments must be published.
- **Remove References To The Powerhouse System** - Removes references to the planned Powerhouse system across the Atlas.
author: adamgfraser
